name: Digital Multimeter
safetyPrecautions: Never measure voltage with the red probe in the 10A current jack — this creates a dead short!
Always verify voltage rating before connecting probes to high-voltage mains (>50V).
Ensure circuit power is completely OFF when measuring resistance or continuity.
Check test leads for cracked insulation or exposed copper before each use.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: लाल प्रोब को 10A करंट जैक में रखकर कभी वोल्टेज न मापें - यह शॉर्ट सर्किट कर सकता है!
उच्च-वोल्टेज मेन्स (>50V) से जोड़ने से पहले हमेशा वोल्टेज रेटिंग सत्यापित करें।
प्रतिरोध या निरंतरता मापते समय सुनिश्चित करें कि सर्किट बिजली पूरी तरह से बंद है।
operatingSteps: Inspect meter casing and test probe leads for cracks or wear.
Plug the BLACK probe into the COM (Common Ground) jack.
Plug the RED probe into the V/Ω/mA jack for voltage/resistance, or into 10A jack ONLY for high current.
Turn the central dial to the desired measurement mode (DCV, ACV, Ω, or Continuity).
Touch probe tips firmly across the component (parallel for Voltage, in-series for Current).
Read the stabilized measurement value on the LCD; switch dial to OFF after session.
operatingStepsHindi: मीटर केसिंग और टेस्ट प्रोब की जांच करें।
काले प्रोब को COM (कॉमन ग्राउंड) जैक में लगाएं।
लाल प्रोब को V/Ω/mA जैक में लगाएं।
रोटरी डायल को वांछित माप मोड (DCV, ACV, Ω) पर सेट करें।
प्रोब सिरों को कंपोनेंट पर लगाएं और स्थिर मान पढ़ें।
commonMistakes: Measuring resistance while the circuit is live (blows internal fuse).
Attempting to measure current in parallel across power supply terminals.
Leaving the selector dial on mA when measuring standard 230V AC lines.

name: Vernier Caliper

specs.Material: Hardened Stainless Steel with satin chrome scale
specs.Functions: External, Internal, Depth, and Step measurements

safetyPrecautions: Avoid dropping the caliper; impact ruins jaw parallelism and introduces zero error.
Do not apply excessive thumb pressure on the sliding jaw to avoid flexing.
Do not measure moving or rotating workpieces on lathes/mills.
Wipe measuring jaws clean of metal chips and oil before taking readings.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: कैलीपर को गिरने से बचाएं; आघात से जबड़े मुड़ सकते हैं।
घूमते हुए वर्कपीस पर कभी भी कैलीपर न लगाएं।
रीडिंग लेने से पहले जबड़ों को साफ कपड़े से पोंछ लें।
operatingSteps: Close the jaws completely and check for Zero Error (Main scale 0 must align with Vernier 0).
Place object between external jaws for outer diameter or thickness.
Gently slide movable jaw until it touches the workpiece without forcing.
Tighten the locking thumb screw on top to freeze the reading.
Read Main Scale Reading (MSR) just to the left of Vernier scale 0 mark.
Find the coinciding Vernier Scale division (VSR) and calculate: Total = MSR + (VSR × Least Count).
operatingStepsHindi: जबड़ों को पूरी तरह बंद करें और शून्य त्रुटि (Zero Error) जांचें।
वस्तु को बाहरी जबड़ों के बीच रखें और हल्के से बंद करें।
लॉकिंग स्क्रू को कसें ताकि रीडिंग स्थिर रहे।
मेन स्केल रीडिंग (MSR) और मेल खाने वाली वर्नियर डिवीजन (VSR) पढ़ें।
कुल मान = MSR + (VSR × 0.02 mm) की गणना करें।
commonMistakes: Forgetting to add or subtract zero error from final reading.
Tilting the caliper at an angle rather than perpendicular to the workpiece axis.
Using excessive force leading to mechanical deformation of soft specimens.

name: Micrometer Screw Gauge

specs.Least Count: 0.01 mm (0.001 mm for digital vernier micrometer)

safetyPrecautions: Always use the ratchet stop knob to close spindle on workpiece, NEVER turn the thimble directly.
Store with a slight gap (1-2mm) between anvil and spindle faces to prevent thermal fusion.
Clean contact anvils with a strip of paper before zero calibration.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: वर्कपीस को दबाते समय हमेशा रैचेट स्टॉप का उपयोग करें, थिम्बल को जोर से न घुमाएं।
उपकरण को स्टोर करते समय एनविल और स्पिंडल के बीच थोड़ा अंतर रखें।
operatingSteps: Clean measuring faces and rotate ratchet until 3 clicks are heard; note any zero error.
Place wire or thin sheet between the anvil and spindle.
Rotate thimble until near the object, then turn ONLY the ratchet until it clicks 3 times.
Engage the lock nut to maintain spindle position.
Note Pitch Scale Reading (PSR) visible on the linear sleeve (in mm and 0.5mm graduations).
Note Circular Scale division aligning with index line (CSR).
Calculate: Total = PSR + (CSR × 0.01 mm) ± Zero Correction.
operatingStepsHindi: मापने वाले सिरों को साफ करें और रैचेट घुमाकर शून्य त्रुटि नोट करें।
वस्तु को एनविल और स्पिंडल के बीच रखें।
रैचेट को 3 बार 'क्लिक' होने तक घुमाएं और लॉक लीवर लगाएं।
लीनियर स्लीव पर PSR और सर्कुलर स्केल पर CSR पढ़ें।
कुल मान = PSR + (CSR × 0.01 mm) निकालें।
commonMistakes: Overtightening the thimble manually, damaging precision micro-threads.
Misreading the 0.5mm bottom sub-division lines on the sleeve.
Parallax error when viewing circular scale division alignment.

name: Digital Storage Oscilloscope
safetyPrecautions: The ground alligator clip of the oscilloscope probe is connected directly to Earth Ground!
Connecting the ground clip to any non-zero voltage point will trigger a destructive ground loop or trip the lab breaker.
Use differential probes or isolation transformers when analyzing ungrounded or mains line circuits.
Check probe 1X/10X attenuation switch matches the channel attenuation setting in oscilloscope menu.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: ऑसिलोस्कोप प्रोब का ग्राउंड क्लिप अर्थ ग्राउंड से जुड़ा होता है!
ग्राउंड क्लिप को कभी भी लाइव वोल्टेज टर्मिनल से न जोड़ें, शॉर्ट सर्किट होगा।
जांचें कि प्रोब का 10X स्विच ऑसिलोस्कोप मेनू सेटिंग से मेल खाता है।
operatingSteps: Power ON the DSO and connect BNC probe to Channel 1 (CH1).
Attach probe tip and ground clip to the 1 kHz / 3.3V Probe Compensation test terminals.
Press the 'AutoSet' or 'Default Setup' button to verify probe calibration square wave.
If square wave has overshoots or undershoots, adjust probe trimmer screw with non-metallic trimmer tool.
Connect ground clip to circuit 0V reference ground and probe tip to signal test point.
Adjust Vertical SCALE (Volts/Div), Horizontal SCALE (Sec/Div), and Trigger Level to stabilize waveform.
Use 'Measure' menu to view Peak-to-Peak (Vpp), Frequency, and RMS voltage automatically.
operatingStepsHindi: DSO को चालू करें और प्रोब को चैनल 1 में लगाएं।
प्रोब को 1kHz टेस्ट लूप पर लगाएं और AutoSet दबाकर वर्ग तरंग की जांच करें।
ग्राउंड क्लिप को सर्किट के ग्राउंड पर और प्रोब टिप को सिग्नल बिंदु पर लगाएं।
वोल्टेज/डिवीजन और टाइम/डिवीजन डायल से तरंग को स्क्रीन पर स्थिर करें।
commonMistakes: Mismatched probe attenuation (1X reading shown as 10X or vice versa gives 10-fold measurement error).
Floating ground clips causing mains hum (50Hz noise) injection into weak signals.
Trigger set incorrectly causing running or blurry unsynchronized wave display.

name: Function / Arbitrary Waveform Generator

specs.Frequency Range: 1 µHz to 25 MHz (Sine / Square / Ramp / Pulse / Noise)
specs.Amplitude Range: 1 mVpp to 10 Vpp into 50 Ω load
specs.Modulation: AM, FM, PM, FSK, PWM, Sweep, Burst

safetyPrecautions: Do NOT feed active external voltage into the generator OUTPUT terminal; back-feeding destroys output amplifier.
Ensure load impedance setting (50Ω vs High-Z) is set properly to prevent amplitude doubling misunderstandings.
Check DC Offset level before connecting to sensitive microcontrollers (3.3V logic can fry if offset > 3.3V).
safetyPrecautionsHindi: आउटपुट सॉकेट में बाहर से वोल्टेज कभी न डालें, आंतरिक परिपथ जल सकता है।
माइक्रोकंट्रोलर से जोड़ने से पहले आउटपुट DC ऑफसेट जांचें।
operatingSteps: Connect 50Ω BNC to Crocodile cable to Channel 1 Main Output.
Select desired Waveform shape button: Sine, Square, Triangle, or Ramp.
Press Frequency button and enter desired frequency (e.g. 1 kHz) using keypad or rotary knob.
Press Amplitude button and specify Vpp (e.g. 2.0 Vpp).
Set DC Offset to 0.0V unless biasing a specific transistor gate.
Verify impedance match (High-Z or 50Ω) in channel utility settings.
Press the glowing 'OUTPUT' toggle button to activate signal generation into your target circuit.
operatingStepsHindi: BNC केबल को चैनल 1 आउटपुट से कनेक्ट करें।
तरंग का प्रकार (साइन, स्क्वायर, त्रिकोणीय) चुनें।
आवृत्ति (Frequency) और आयाम (Amplitude Vpp) सेट करें।
सर्किट में सिग्नल भेजने के लिए 'OUTPUT' बटन दबाएं।
commonMistakes: Leaving Output button OFF and wondering why the circuit receives no signal.
Assuming 2Vpp into an oscilloscope on 1MΩ mode when generator is calibrated for 50Ω termination (shows 4Vpp).
Excessive DC offset exceeding microcontroller ADC voltage rails.

name: Regulated DC Power Supply

specs.Protection: Current limit, Short circuit, Over-temperature protection

safetyPrecautions: Set the CURRENT LIMIT before connecting to your breadboard circuit to protect sensitive ICs from smoke upon short.
Double check polarity (RED = Positive +, BLACK = Negative -, GREEN = Earth Ground) before turning Output ON.
Never connect two independent power supplies in parallel without reverse-blocking diodes.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: सर्किट जोड़ने से पहले करंट लिमिट (Current Limit) सेट करें।
ध्रुवीयता (लाल = +, काला = -) की दोबारा जांच करें।
शॉर्ट सर्किट से बचने के लिए आउटपुट बंद करके तार जोड़ें।
operatingSteps: Turn Voltage and Current knobs fully counter-clockwise before powering on unit.
Power ON the unit; ensure Output switch is initially in the OFF position.
Set desired test Voltage (e.g. 5.0V) using Coarse and Fine voltage knobs.
To set safe Current Limit: temporarily short red and black lead tips together, adjust Current knob to desired cutoff (e.g. 200mA), then separate leads.
Connect Red (+) lead to circuit VCC and Black (-) lead to circuit GND.
Press the 'Output' button ON and watch the LED amp meter to confirm normal current draw.
operatingStepsHindi: बिजली चालू करने से पहले नॉब को शून्य पर रखें।
वांछित वोल्टेज (उदा. 5V) सेट करें।
करंट लिमिट नॉब को सुरक्षित सीमा (उदा. 200mA) पर सेट करें।
लाल तार को VCC और काले तार को GND से जोड़कर आउटपुट चालू करें।
commonMistakes: Current knob left at zero, causing power supply to clamp voltage to 0V (constant current mode CC trap).
Reversing polarity and immediately destroying polarized electrolytic capacitors and microcontrollers.
Connecting positive lead directly to earth ground screw instead of floating negative terminal.

name: Solderless Breadboard

specs.Tie Points: 830 tie points (630 point terminal strip + 200 point power rails)
specs.Wire Compatibility: 21 – 26 AWG (0.4 – 0.7 mm diameter) solid core wire
specs.Max Voltage / Current: 36V DC / 1.5A Max rating per contact rail

safetyPrecautions: Do NOT use breadboards for high current circuits (>1.5A) or AC mains 230V — clips will overheat and melt plastic.
Turn off the power supply whenever inserting or rearranging jumper wires and components.
Avoid forcing oversized component leads into tie points which permanently loosens spring grips.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: ब्रेडबोर्ड पर 230V AC मेन्स या 1.5A से अधिक करंट कभी न लगाएं।
पुर्जे लगाते या हटाते समय पावर सप्लाई बंद रखें।
operatingSteps: Identify the outer long rails marked '+' (Red) and '-' (Blue) running vertically as common Power Buses.
Note the middle columns: rows of 5 pins (A-B-C-D-E and F-G-H-I-J) are connected horizontally together.
Straddle dual inline package (DIP) IC chips across the central trench so opposite pins are electrically isolated.
Use neat, colour-coded jumper wires (Red for Power, Black for Ground, Yellow/Green for signals).
Check for accidental short circuits between adjacent pin clips using a multimeter continuity buzzer before applying power.
operatingStepsHindi: लाल (+) और नीली (-) लंबी पटरियों को पावर रेल के रूप में पहचानें।
बीच में 5-5 छिद्रों की क्षैतिज लाइनों को समझें।
IC चिप्स को केंद्रीय नाली के आर-पार लगाएं ताकि विपरीत पिन अलग रहें।
पावर ऑन करने से पहले मल्टीमीटर से शॉर्ट सर्किट जांचें।
commonMistakes: Placing both legs of a resistor or LED in the exact same 5-hole row, shorting it out.
Assuming power rails are continuous on extra-long breadboards that have a split in the middle.
Pushing stranded wire directly into tie points causing stray strand shorts.

name: Temperature-Controlled Soldering Station
safetyPrecautions: HOT SURFACE HAZARD: Iron tip reaches 400°C within seconds. Touching causes severe third-degree flesh burns.
FUME INHALATION: Solder rosin flux releases toxic fumes and lead vapors; use active fume extractor or work in well-ventilated space.
FIRE HAZARD: Always return hot iron to its fireproof metal stand. Never rest iron on tables or power cables.
WASH HANDS with soap and water after handling lead-based (60/40) solder.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: गंभीर जलने का खतरा: टिप 400°C तक गर्म होती है, धातु को कभी न छुएं!
हानिकारक धुएं से बचें: फ्यूम एक्सट्रैक्टर या हवादार कमरे में काम करें।
आयरन को हमेशा उसके मेटल स्टैंड में ही रखें।
लेड सोल्डर छूने के बाद साबुन से हाथ धोएं।
operatingSteps: Dampen the brass wire cleaner or cellulose sponge with water (sponge should be moist, not dripping).
Switch ON station and set temperature: ~320°C for leaded solder (60/40) or ~360°C for lead-free solder.
Once heated, clean the tip on brass sponge and immediately apply fresh solder to 'tin' the tip shiny silver.
Touch tip simultaneously to BOTH the component pin and the PCB copper pad for 2 seconds to heat the joint.
Feed solder wire into the opposite side of the heated joint, NOT directly onto the iron tip.
Remove solder wire first, then remove iron tip 1 second later; allow joint to cool undisturbed for 5 seconds.
Inspect the finished solder joint: it should be concave, shiny, and resemble a miniature volcano cone.
operatingStepsHindi: स्पंज को हल्का गीला करें और सोल्डरिंग स्टेशन ऑन करें।
तापमान 320°C - 350°C पर सेट करें।
टिप को ब्रास स्पंज पर साफ करके थोड़ा सोल्डर लगाकर टिनिंग करें।
टिप को कंपोनेंट पिन और पैड दोनों पर 2 सेकंड छुएं, फिर सोल्डर वायर लगाएं।
ज्वाइंट को बिना हिलाए 5 सेकंड ठंडा होने दें।
commonMistakes: Cold solder joint caused by moving the wire while cooling or insufficient heating time.
Solder bridges connecting two adjacent PCB pads together causing shorts.
Leaving iron tip oxidized and blackened without tinning, destroying heat transfer.

name: Arduino Uno R3 / R4

specs.Operating Voltage: 5V logic (7-12V recommended input on DC barrel jack)

safetyPrecautions: Never draw more than 20mA from any single digital pin, or more than 200mA total from the entire chip.
Do NOT drive inductive loads (DC motors, solenoids, relays) directly from I/O pins without flyback diode and transistor driver.
Avoid supplying more than 5.5V to the 5V pin or reverse polarity to Vin.
Do not place the powered board onto conductive aluminum benches or solder wire clippings.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: किसी भी पिन से 20mA से अधिक करंट न लें।
मोटर या रिले को सीधे पिन से न जोड़ें, ड्राइवर मॉड्यूल का उपयोग करें।
चालू बोर्ड को धातु की मेज या सोल्डर के टुकड़ों पर न रखें।
operatingSteps: Connect USB Type-B cable from computer to Arduino Uno USB port.
Open Arduino IDE, select Tools > Board > 'Arduino Uno' and select the matching COM port.
Write or open your sketch (e.g., File > Examples > 01.Basics > Blink).
Click 'Verify' (Checkmark icon) to compile the C++ source code.
Click 'Upload' (Arrow icon) and watch the TX/RX LEDs pulse as machine code flashes into memory.
Observe built-in pin 13 LED blink or open Tools > Serial Monitor at matching baud rate (9600) to view debug data.
operatingStepsHindi: USB केबल से आर्डुइनो को कंप्यूटर से कनेक्ट करें।
Arduino IDE में Tools > Board > 'Arduino Uno' और सही COM पोर्ट चुनें।
कोड लिखें और 'Verify' बटन से कंपाइल करें।
'Upload' बटन दबाकर प्रोग्राम बोर्ड में लोड करें।
commonMistakes: Trying to power high-torque servo motors directly from Arduino 5V regulator causing brownout resets.
Wrong COM port selected in Arduino IDE resulting in 'avrdude: stk500_recv(): programmer is not responding'.
Forgetting current-limiting resistors (220Ω - 330Ω) in series with external LEDs.

name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B

specs.Processor: Broadcom BCM2711, Quad-core Cortex-A72 (ARM v8) 64-bit SoC @ 1.8GHz
specs.GPIO Header: 40-pin standard GPIO (3.3V logic ONLY, NOT 5V tolerant!)
specs.Connectivity: Dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.0 BLE, Gigabit Ethernet
specs.Power Requirement: 5V DC via USB-C connector (minimum 3.0A power supply)

safetyPrecautions: CRITICAL: Raspberry Pi GPIO pins operate strictly on 3.3V logic and ARE NOT 5V tolerant. 5V input will permanently destroy the CPU.
Always perform a software shutdown ('sudo poweroff') before pulling the power cord to prevent micro-SD card corruption.
Use heatsinks and miniature cooling fan; SoC throttles performance when temperature crosses 80°C.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: महत्वपूर्ण: GPIO पिन केवल 3.3V सहन कर सकते हैं, 5V लगाने पर प्रोसेसर तुरंत खराब हो जाएगा!
पावर केबल खींचने से पहले हमेशा 'sudo poweroff' कमांड चलाएं।
operatingSteps: Flash Raspberry Pi OS onto a Class 10 A2 MicroSD card using Raspberry Pi Imager.
Insert microSD card into the bottom slot until fully seated.
Attach micro-HDMI cable to monitor and connect USB keyboard/mouse.
Connect certified 5V 3.0A USB-C power supply to power boot sequence.
Wait for desktop environment or SSH terminal login (default user: pi).
Access GPIO using Python RPi.GPIO or gpiozero libraries, always referencing pinout diagrams.
operatingStepsHindi: माइक्रो-एसडी कार्ड में OS फ्लैश करके स्लॉट में डालें।
HDMI, कीबोर्ड और 5V 3A टाइप-C अडैप्टर लगाएं।
सिस्टम बूट होने की प्रतीक्षा करें।
पिनआउट देखकर 3.3V सेंसर जोड़ें और काम खत्म होने पर 'sudo shutdown' करें।
commonMistakes: Plugging 5V sensors directly into GPIO pins without bidirectional logic level converters.
Using low-amperage phone chargers causing lightning bolt low-voltage under-voltage warnings.
Sudden power disconnection corrupting Linux root filesystem.

name: Laboratory Bunsen Burner

specs.Flame Temperature: Safety Luminous Flame ~300°C; Non-luminous Roaring Blue Flame up to 1500°C
specs.Construction: Heavy zinc/cast-iron base with nickel-plated brass tube

safetyPrecautions: FIRE HAZARD: Tie back long hair, remove dangling scarves/jewelry, and wear 100% cotton lab coat.
Never leave a burning flame unattended, even for 30 seconds.
Always light burner with air hole CLOSED (safety luminous yellow flame) before opening air collar to blue heating flame.
Keep flammable solvents (Ethanol, Acetone, Ether) at least 5 meters away from open flame.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: आग का भारी खतरा: बाल बांधें और ढीले कपड़े न पहनें।
जलते हुए बर्नर को कभी अकेला न छोड़ें।
जलाते समय हवा की खिड़की (एयर कॉलर) बंद रखें ताकि पीली सेफ्टी लौ बने।
अल्कोहल या एसीटोन जैसे ज्वलनशील पदार्थ दूर रखें।
operatingSteps: Inspect rubber gas tubing for dry rot, cracks, or loose hose clamps.
Ensure the air intake collar at the base of burner chimney is completely CLOSED.
Light flint striker or long match and hold it 3 cm above and slightly to the side of chimney top.
Turn main lab bench gas tap ON to start gas flow until yellow luminous flame lights.
Slowly rotate the air collar to open air holes; flame transitions from smoky yellow to a roaring blue double cone.
Position beaker or crucible on tripod with wire gauze above the apex of the inner blue cone (hottest point ~1400°C).
When heating is finished, close air collar back to yellow flame first, then turn off bench gas valve completely.
operatingStepsHindi: गैस पाइप की जांच करें कि कहीं रिसाव तो नहीं है।
एयर कॉलर को बंद करें।
माचिस की तीली या स्पार्कर को बर्नर के ऊपर रखें और गैस वाल्व खोलें।
पीली लौ जलने के बाद एयर कॉलर खोलें ताकि नीली तेज लौ बने।
काम पूरा होने पर गैस वाल्व बंद करें।
commonMistakes: Lighting burner with air hole fully open causing dangerous flashback (flame burns inside tube with loud hiss).
Touching hot tripod, wire gauze, or glassware with bare hands immediately after heating.
Heating a sealed glass vessel with no pressure relief.

name: Graduated Measuring Cylinder & Beaker

specs.Capacity: 100 mL / 250 mL / 500 mL Class A / Class B
specs.Material: Borosilicate 3.3 Glass (thermal shock resistant up to 400°C) or Polypropylene

safetyPrecautions: Inspect glass rim, spout, and base for chips or hairline cracks before adding reagents.
Never measure boiling liquids in volumetric measuring cylinders (calibrated strictly at 20°C).
Always pour acids INTO water slowly with stirring, NEVER pour water into concentrated acid (exothermic steam splattering).
safetyPrecautionsHindi: कांच के किनारों पर दरारें जांचें।
हमेशा पानी में तेजाब धीरे-धीरे मिलाएं, तेजाब में पानी कभी न डालें!
रीडिंग लेते समय आंखों को मेनिस्कस के स्तर पर रखें।
operatingSteps: Place measuring cylinder onto a completely flat and level workbench.
Carefully pour liquid down the inside wall of the cylinder to prevent splashing and bubble formation.
Bring eye level exactly horizontal with the liquid surface to avoid parallax error.
For transparent/wetting liquids (water, dilute acids), read the bottom of the curved meniscus.
For mercury or opaque liquids, read the top convex meniscus curve.
Record reading with correct significant figures based on cylinder least count.
operatingStepsHindi: सिलेंडर को सपाट मेज पर रखें।
तरल को धीरे-धीरे अंदर डालें ताकि छींटे न उड़ें।
आंख को द्रव की सतह के स्तर पर लाएं।
पानी के लिए अवतल मेनिस्कस (नीचे का तल) पढ़ें।
commonMistakes: Holding cylinder in hand at eye level instead of resting on bench, creating inaccurate tilt angles.
Using beakers for precise volume measurement (beaker graduation lines have ±10% error margin).
Misidentifying the bottom of the meniscus in dim lighting.

name: Precision Analytical Balance
safetyPrecautions: Never place chemical reagents directly on the bare stainless steel weighing pan; use butter paper or a tared weigh boat.
Clean any spilled chemical powders immediately with a camel-hair brush to prevent corrosion.
Do NOT exceed maximum capacity (220g) to prevent straining internal electromagnetic force restoration load cell.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: रसायनों को सीधे स्टील पैन पर न रखें, हमेशा बटर पेपर या कंटेनर का उपयोग करें।
हवा के झोंकों से बचने के लिए कांच के दरवाजे बंद रखें।
क्षमता (220 ग्राम) से अधिक वजन न रखें।
operatingSteps: Check spirit bubble level at rear of balance; adjust leveling feet so bubble rests in exact center circle.
Close all glass draft shield doors and press 'TARE' or 'ZERO' button until display reads 0.0000 g.
Slide open door, place empty weighing boat or watch glass onto pan center, and close door.
Press 'TARE' button to zero out container weight (display returns to 0.0000 g).
Open door, dispense sample into boat with clean spatula, and close draft shield door.
Wait 2 seconds for stability symbol (circle or asterisk) to illuminate before recording final mass.
operatingStepsHindi: पीछे लगे स्पिरिट लेवल की जांच करें कि बुलबुला केंद्र में है।
दरवाजे बंद करें और 'TARE' बटन दबाकर 0.0000g करें।
खाली बर्तन रखें और फिर से 'TARE' दबाएं।
नमूना डालकर दरवाजे बंद करें और स्थिर रीडिंग नोट करें।
commonMistakes: Weighing with draft shield doors open; room ventilation currents cause wild gram fluctuations.
Weighing warm or cold objects; convection currents within draft chamber create false mass readings.
Leaning heavily on the balance stone table while taking reading.

name: Digital Optical Tachometer & Stopwatch
safetyPrecautions: LASER HAZARD: Class II laser beam. Do not stare into beam or point laser at eyes of colleagues.
ROTATING MACHINERY HAZARD: Keep hair, loose clothing, and hands away from high-speed spinning shafts and pulleys.
Ensure machine guard is in place before spinning motor up to high RPM.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: लेजर किरण को कभी भी आंखों की तरफ न करें।
घूमती हुई मोटर या शाफ्ट से बाल और कपड़े दूर रखें।
operatingSteps: Ensure the rotating motor or shaft is completely stopped.
Affix a small strip (approx 12mm x 12mm) of self-adhesive reflective silver tape onto the rotating shaft.
Stand at a safe distance (150-300mm) perpendicular to the target shaft.
Power ON the machine motor and aim the tachometer laser spot directly onto the reflective tape path.
Hold down the 'MEASURE' trigger button; watch RPM readout update in real-time.
Release trigger to freeze and record MAX, MIN, and LAST recorded RPM values.
operatingStepsHindi: मोटर बंद करके शाफ्ट पर रिफ्लेक्टिव टेप चिपकाएं।
सुरक्षित दूरी पर खड़े होकर लेजर को टेप पर केंद्रित करें।
माप ट्रिगर दबाएं और स्क्रीन पर RPM पढ़ें।
commonMistakes: Failing to stick high-contrast reflective tape on matte or dirty shafts.
Holding tachometer at too steep an angle where reflected laser miss sensor photodiode.
Standing in line of fire of unshielded rotating couplings.

name: Safety Goggles & PPE Kit

specs.Standard Compliance: ANSI Z87.1+ / EN 166 (Impact & Chemical Splash Certified)
specs.Lens Material: Polycarbonate with Anti-Scratch & Anti-Fog coating (UV400 protection)
specs.Lab Coat Fabric: 100% Pre-shrunk White Cotton Twill with snap closures and knit cuffs
specs.Venting: Indirect ventilation baffles preventing liquid aerosol ingress

safetyPrecautions: Never enter active mechanical, chemical, or laser test zones without donning approved safety glasses.
Regular prescription spectacles do NOT provide ANSI impact or side-splash protection.
Button lab coat fully from collar to waist; never wear synthetic polyester coats near open flames.
safetyPrecautionsHindi: बिना सुरक्षा चश्मे के कभी भी प्रयोगशाला में प्रवेश न करें।
साधारण नजर का चश्मा पर्याप्त सुरक्षा नहीं देता।
लैब कोट के सभी बटन बंद रखें।
operatingSteps: Inspect goggles for cracked lenses, degraded headband elastic, or cloudy scratch marks.
Put on cotton lab coat and fasten all front buttons and sleeve cuffs.
Place goggles comfortably over eyes; tighten adjustable headband until snug around head without pressure pinch.
Ensure indirect ventilation ports are clean and facing backward.
Wear goggles throughout the entirety of the experiment until leaving the laboratory floor.
operatingStepsHindi: चश्मे के लेंस और पट्टे की जांच करें।
लैब कोट पहनकर सारे बटन बंद करें।
चश्मे को आंखों पर सही से लगाएं और पट्टा कसें।
प्रयोगशाला में रहने तक चश्मा कभी न उतारें।
commonMistakes: Resting safety goggles on the forehead or dangling around the neck.
Wearing loose synthetic clothing beneath the lab coat that can melt onto skin.
Wearing open sandals or mesh athletic shoes in laboratories with liquid or falling tool hazards.
